CommunityApplications.Profile:
Projectionist is cinema intelligence for your personal archive — a chat-first companion for self-hosted Plex libraries. Connect Plex, Radarr, Sonarr, TMDB, and your preferred LLM (or Ollama on the Unraid host). Features include RAG over your library, confirmation-gated *arr actions, optional household Sign in with Plex, and dual-mode MCP (privacy + full).
**Support:** GitHub Issues — https://github.com/romwil/projectionist/issues **Docs:** https://github.com/romwil/projectionist/tree/main/docs **Install notes:** https://github.com/romwil/projectionist/blob/main/docs/wiki/Unraid.md
Keep port 8788 on a trusted LAN; do not WAN-expose without an authenticated reverse proxy.
**Updating:** if Docker Force Update reports TOTAL DATA PULLED: 0 B, run `docker pull romwil/projectionist:latest` (or appdata `./rollout.sh`) then recreate — see wiki Unraid / DOCKER.md. During the compatibility window the same digests are also published as `romwil/curatorx:*`.
